note: Usage policy per Dutch venue. 'discovery': true adds concerts found on the venue's own site (facts plus a link to the official page). 'imageUse' controls official event artwork: 'pending' stores matched images as candidates only; set it to 'permitted' ONLY with written permission or published terms that allow it, recorded in 'imageUseEvidence' (who, when, scope). 'denied' never stores candidates. Access findings come from the read-only probe of 2026-11-05 (docs/venue-first-images.md).

paradiso.source: sitemap event_N.xml + JSON-LD Event (performers, timezone date)

doornroosje.source: homepage agenda + JSON-LD Event (local time labelled UTC)

patronaat.source: /programma + date in event URL + Open Graph title

tivoli.access: blocked: Cloudflare HTTP 403 for automated clients; ask the venue for a feed

melkweg.access: blocked: AWS WAF challenge on every URL; ask the venue for a feed
